# 0.5.15

## 本次更新

- 修复登录成功后首页无法加载的问题：网页会话验证此前读取的键名与 DeviantArt 实际页面不符（`@publicSession` 应为 `@@publicSession`），登录完成后首页始终判定“会话不可用”并显示加载失败，本版已按真实页面结构修正。
- 会话身份判定同时解析 `isLoggedIn` 标志：未登录页面立即判定匿名；已登录但用户名尚未渲染时保持“未验证”，不再误判。
- 登录页自动关闭与个性化推荐自动恢复正常工作（解析修正后整条链路畅通）。
- 新增基于生产页面真实结构的回归测试；采纳永久工程规则：外部协议解析必须先对照实抓证据验证，测试样本不得按当前实现反推。

## Changes (English)

- Fixed the bug where the home feed failed to load after a successful login: web-session verification read the wrong key (`@publicSession` instead of the real `@@publicSession`), so the feed was always rejected as "session unavailable" before reaching the network.
- Session identity now also parses the `isLoggedIn` flag: signed-out pages are recognized as anonymous immediately, while a signed-in page whose username has not rendered yet stays "unverified" instead of being misjudged.
- Login-page auto-close and personalized-feed auto-recovery work again once parsing matches the real page.
- Added regression tests built from the real production page structure, and adopted a permanent engineering rule: external protocol parsing must be verified against independently captured real evidence, never reverse-engineered from the implementation.
